newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Nu Skin, CANTV options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Nu Skin, CANTV options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Wednesday it would begin trading options on shares of Nu Skin Asia Pacific Inc from February 27 and on American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) of Venezuela's CANTV from March 3.
The exchange said Nu Skin options would open with strike prices of 25, 30 and 35 and initial expirations in March, April, June and September. Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
It said LETCO-Specialist LP would be the specialist unit.
Nu Skin shares finished up 3/8 at 29-3/8 Wednesday.
For CANTV, the options will have opening strikes of 25, 30 and 35, with initial expirations in March, April, July and October, the AMEX said. Position limits of 7,500 contracts have been set.
LETCO-Specialist LP has also been named specialist for the CANTV options.
CANTV shares in the U.S. closed Wednesday up 5/8 at 33-1/4.
